caption: Figure 4 | Error and observation retention in high-fire-proxy months. (A) Full-model RMSE for P90 fire-proxy and other months across fixed-window country-years. (B) Retention of 2023 high-fire station-months under distance <50 km combined with non-geographic training min–max or P01–P99 bounds. The unrestricted sample is a reference. Canadian models with meteorology retain 466/725 observations (64.3%) under min–max and 302/725 (41.7%) under P01–P99 bounds. Rows group country/year in (A) and country in (B); color and offsets distinguish meteorological profiles. RMSE is in µg m⁻³; retention uses all eligible high-fire station-months as the denominator. P90 marks months above the regional fire-feature 90th percentile in the outer training set; P01–P99 denotes the training first-to-ninety-ninth-percentile range.
